title: Where to Eat Late at Night in Berlin - Quick Summary
items: **Many Berlin restaurant kitchens stop hot food around 22:00 or 23:00**, even if the bar stays open. Check the venue's own final kitchen time.
**Late food often clusters around transport hubs.** Kottbusser Tor, Schlesisches Tor, Hermannplatz and Warschauer Straße put several counters within a short walk, but exact hours vary.
**After midnight, plan around counters and kiosks.** Döner, falafel and other takeaway options are a safer starting point than assuming a sit-down menu is still running.
**Sunday Späti opening is not guaranteed.** Berlin allows only narrow shop-law exceptions, so check the exact shop rather than relying on the Späti label.
**Do not cross the city for one unverified listing.** Compare live options near your current station, then choose the cluster with several open candidates.

**Weekend-night transport keeps running, but frequencies differ:** Berlin lists about 15 minutes for U-Bahn and 30 minutes for S-Bahn; on other nights use the live BVG journey planner for N buses and Metrotram.
